comment: Read from src/Spectrum.cpp and src/spectrum at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1. This is the module the installed 2.11.1 differs from the 2.11.0 manual over: that release made the panel resizable, which the manual does not mention. The Channel mode parameter has no widget of its own (Spectrum.cpp:136 against the widget's addParam calls), so no click can reach it; it is set from the menu instead. The floor runs -140 to -40 dBFS and the speed is a power of two between the shortest and longest history the module holds (Spectrum.cpp:27 to 29 and SpectrumTypes.hpp:98). The display's hover readout, zoom and pan are handled by the display widget, which is not a parameter, so none of them can be clicked for help.
